looper.title: Looper
looper.intro: Press MIX (after Mixer, Mute and Solo) or SONG to open it. Tap or touch the highlighted parts; every track column works the same.

items.title: Top row
items.text: Shows what each track's knob is turning right now (for example its level, or the pan).

items.title: Record box
items.text: The track's record button. Red = recording, yellow = overdubbing, green = playing, grey = empty. Hold to record while held, double-tap to latch recording on, tap to keep the take. The first take sets the loop length.

items.title: SELECT
items.text: Makes this track the one the hardware REC and BACK buttons act on.

items.title: Level fader
items.text: Drag it, or turn the track's knob. The white dot is the level; the coloured line is the track's colour.

items.title: Level readout
items.text: The track's level in dB.

items.title: UNDO
items.text: Says what the next press does: UNDO PASS takes the last recorded pass off (yellow), DELETE LOOP clears the track (red).

items.title: PAN
items.text: The track's pan. Tap it and the track's knob turns the pan instead of the level; tap again to give the knob back.

items.title: REV
items.text: Plays the loop backwards.

items.title: MUTE
items.text: Mutes the track.

items.title: Page tabs
items.text: MAIN (this page), FX and FX2 (the track effects), SETUP (the options).

items.title: STOCK FX
items.text: Opens the Blackbox's own FX page.

items.title: Pink square
items.text: The four controls in the pink square are the four knobs of the Blackbox: knob 1 bottom-left, 2 top-left, 3 top-right, 4 bottom-right (the small numbers show it). Tap a dial to move the square; INFO moves it on.

items.title: FILT
items.text: Filter. Left of centre = low-pass, right of centre = high-pass, centre = off.

items.title: RES
items.text: Resonance of the filter.

items.title: CRSH
items.text: Crunch: bit and sample-rate reduction.

items.title: DRIVE
items.text: Drive: pushes the track into saturation.

items.title: DLY
items.text: Send into the looper's own delay.

items.title: RVB
items.text: Send into the looper's own reverb.

items.title: REV
items.text: Plays the track backwards.

items.title: HALF
items.text: Half speed.

items.title: MUTE
items.text: Mutes the track.

items.title: UNDO / DEL
items.text: Takes the last pass off, or deletes the loop (the label says which).

items.title: Pink square
items.text: The four controls in the pink square are the four knobs of the Blackbox: knob 1 bottom-left, 2 top-left, 3 top-right, 4 bottom-right (the small numbers show it). Tap a dial to move the square; INFO moves it on.

items.title: STAB
items.text: Tape instability: wow, flutter, a little noise and dulling.

items.title: RPT
items.text: How much of the old loop each overdub keeps. Left: it fades quickly; right: it stays.

items.title: SPEED
items.text: Playback speed. Centre = normal, right up to 2x, left slows down through stopped to backwards.

items.title: WOB
items.text: An auto-pan. The knob is its speed: left slow and wide, right fast and narrow.

items.title: POS
items.text: Where the loop starts, 0 to 100 % of its length.

items.title: STUT
items.text: Repeats a slice of a beat. Left: the slice that just played; right: the one that comes next. The further, the shorter.

items.title: SCRM
items.text: Jumps between slices of the loop. Left: at random; right: in a repeating sequence.

items.title: PTCH
items.text: Pitch shift without changing the speed, up to 24 semitones either way.

items.title: MUTE
items.text: Mutes the track.

items.title: UNDO / DEL
items.text: Takes the last pass off, or deletes the loop (the label says which).

items.title: LENGTH
items.text: How long later tracks are. FOLLOW = as long as the first loop, MULT = a multiple of it, FREE = whatever you record.

items.title: SYNC
items.text: Locks recording and playback to the Blackbox tempo.

items.title: QUANT
items.text: The grid for starting and stopping when SYNC is on: 1 bar, 1/4, 1/8 or 1/16.

items.title: SOURCE
items.text: What gets recorded: the INPUT, or the Blackbox's own MIX.

items.title: HW STOP PLAY
items.text: Whether the hardware STOP and PLAY buttons run only the looper, or also the Blackbox's own transport (+STOCK).

items.title: FX ON EMPTY
items.text: When a track is emptied: KEEP its FX settings, or RESET them to their defaults.

items.title: SPEED PITCH
items.text: How speed and pitch changes are made: TAPE (like a tape machine), GRAIN (granular) or SMOOTH (smoother, uses more CPU).

items.title: LOOPER OUT
items.text: Which output the looper plays to: OUT 1, 2 or 3.

items.title: CLEAR ALL
items.text: Clears every track. It asks once: press it again to confirm.

items.title: SAVE
items.text: Saves the looper's options with the project.

items.title: LOOP GAIN
items.text: The loops' level (knob 1).

items.title: MONITOR
items.text: How much of the live input you hear while looping (knob 4).

samplr.title: SAMPLR
samplr.intro: Open it with SONG, right after the Looper. It plays a sample from your pads with your fingers.

items.title: Track line
items.text: The selected sample slot: track number, mode, number of slices, attack and release.

items.title: Sample slots 1-6
items.text: Six sample slots. Each keeps its own sample (taken from a pad), mode and settings.

items.title: Octave and transpose
items.text: -12 and +12 move the pitch an octave. The middle one shows the transpose: drag it sideways for single semitones, tap it for 0.

items.title: REV
items.text: Plays everything backwards.

items.title: REC
items.text: The gesture recorder: records what your fingers do, then loops it with the Blackbox clock. Three layers.

items.title: PLAY / STOP
items.text: Starts and stops the recorded gesture loop (it waits for the next bar line).

items.title: Waveform
items.text: The sample with its slice markers. Touch it to play (up to four fingers); how high you touch sets volume (or pitch, with YP).

items.title: Encoder corners
items.text: The four knobs: ATK attack (top-left), REL release (top-right), SLICES number of slices (bottom-left), VOL volume (bottom-right).

items.title: Sheet tabs
items.text: PLAY (the mode's switches), REC (the take), FX, SMPL (the sample and the mode).

items.title: SAVE
items.text: Saves SAMPLR's settings with the project.

items.title: Q
items.text: Starts slices on the grid: off, 1/4, 1/8 or 1/16. Tap to cycle.

items.title: ONE / GATE / LOOP
items.text: ONE plays a slice once, GATE plays it while you hold, LOOP loops it.

items.title: LATCH
items.text: A slice keeps playing after you lift your finger; touch it again to stop.

items.title: AUTO
items.text: AUTO SLICE: finds the hits in the sample and cuts the slices there.

items.title: YP
items.text: Finger height changes the pitch instead of the volume.

items.title: SEQ
items.text: Plays the slices one after another from the one you press. SEQ NAT lets each slice play to its end; SEQ GRID plays one slice per grid step.

items.title: Pattern
items.text: The order of that sequence: up, down, up-down or random.

items.title: CLR
items.text: Clears the whole take.

items.title: Length
items.text: How many bars the take lasts. Tap to change.

items.title: L1 L2 L3
items.text: The three layers. Grey = empty, cyan = recorded, red = recording.

items.title: PANIC
items.text: Stops every sound at once. Tap it twice.

items.title: FILT
items.text: Filter, as on the pads: low-pass to the left, high-pass to the right, off at the centre.

items.title: RES
items.text: Resonance of the filter.

items.title: REV
items.text: Reverb send.

items.title: DLY
items.text: Delay send.

items.title: A
items.text: Attack time of the sample's volume envelope.

items.title: R
items.text: Release time of the volume envelope.

items.title: Modes
items.text: The five ways to play the sample. SLICE: cut into slices you play with your fingers. TAPE: scrub it like a tape. ARP: step through it as an arpeggiator. GRAIN: a granular cloud. LOOP: loop a section.

items.title: Waveform
items.text: The sample with its slice markers.

items.title: Sample picker
items.text: < and > choose the previous or next sample; the name in the middle is the current one.

items.title: HIGHQ
items.text: The interpolation quality used when the sample is played at another pitch.

items.title: Sheet tabs
items.text: PLAY, REC, FX and SMPL.

items.title: SAVE

drone.title: DRONE-8
drone.intro: Open it with SONG, after Trigger2MIDI. The eight voices are always at the bottom; the tab above them changes. The four encoders turn the four knobs of the orange-framed group.

items.title: Top bar
items.text: Six switches. BTN: the eight round buttons are the voice plates (off: they are the normal Blackbox buttons). REC: the gesture recorder. STEP/FREE: an encoder click moves a note at a time, or in fine steps. X:IN / X:MIX / X:ALL: the audio source on the external input. TRI/SINE: the oscillator wave. LATCH/HOLD: a plate toggles, or only sounds while held.

items.title: MOD
items.text: How strongly the pair's oscillators modulate each other's frequency (FM).

items.title: SHARP
items.text: Reshapes the wave: from soft toward a hard square.

items.title: FM source
items.text: What modulates the pair: SELF, OFF, the LFO, EXT (the audio input), another pair (P1-2 ... P7-8) or OUT (the master output). Tap to cycle; double-tap to reset.

items.title: TOUCH
items.text: How the plate opens the voices: SLOW or FAST envelope, or EXT (the external input opens them).

items.title: Level and tune knobs
items.text: Each pair of voices has two small LEVEL knobs above its two TUNE knobs. The four encoders turn the four knobs of the orange-framed group.

items.title: Voice plates 1-8
items.text: Tap to switch a voice on or off (or hold it, with HOLD). The eight round buttons do the same.

items.title: Page tabs
items.text: VOICES, SOUND, CHORD, MIX and CTRL are the pages; SAVE stores the settings with the project.

items.title: DELAY
items.text: The two delay lines: TIME 1 and TIME 2, feedback (FDBK) and the wet/dry MIX.

items.title: DLY MOD / SYNC
items.text: MOD 1 and 2 wobble the delay times; SYNC 1 and 2 lock the delay times to the Blackbox tempo (a division, or OFF).

items.title: LFO + SYNC
items.text: The two LFOs: their speeds (LFO A, LFO B) and their tempo sync (SYNCA, SYNCB).

items.title: LFO SHAPE
items.text: SHAPE: triangle or square. COMB: how the two LFOs combine, AND or OR. LINK: ties A to B. DLYMD: what modulates the delay (SELF, OFF or LFO).

items.title: TONAL SPACE
items.text: Pick a chord or scale (SPACE), its root (KEY), the lowest octave (OCT) and how far the notes spread (SPAN).

items.title: VOICING
items.text: CHORD ON: the eight voices play notes of that space. SHUFL deals the notes to the voices again. QUANT snaps the voices to the nearest real note once. CYCLE rotates the notes between voices.

items.title: Notes of voices 1-4 and 5-8
items.text: The note each voice plays now. The knobs below can move them by hand.

items.title: OUTPUT
items.text: DRIVE and DIST: two kinds of distortion. VOL: master volume. EXT: level of the external input.

items.title: PITCH
items.text: P 1-4 and P 5-8 move the pitch of the two groups of voices. VIB switches the vibrato. TUNE: EQUAL or JUST tuning.

items.title: GESTURE
items.text: The gesture recorder: REC, LEN (how many bars), UNDO the last layer, LOOP stops or starts the loop.

items.title: FEEL
items.text: SPREAD: the stereo width (0 = mono). DRIFT: slow random pitch wander. VERB: reverb. POWER: switches the engine on or off.

items.text: The fast envelope: attack time and release factor.

items.title: SLOW

items.title: VELOCITY
items.text: Where plate velocity comes from (STEADY, TOUCH, SLIDE or MIDI) and how much it matters (AMT).

items.title: MIDI LEARN
items.text: LEARN, then touch a knob or button and move a controller or play a note to bind them. FORGET LAST and CLEAR remove bindings. The counters show messages from the jack, USB and raw USB.

trig.title: Trigger2MIDI
trig.intro: Open it with SONG, after SAMPLR. Plug drums or triggers into the two audio inputs. Tap a row to hand it to the four knobs (pink frame).

items.title: Top bar
items.text: Hit counts and the last velocity of each input (L and R).

items.title: IN L / IN R
items.text: Chooses which input the page and its knobs show.

items.title: ON
items.text: Switches the shown input on or off.

items.title: TRS / USB / INT
items.text: Where the notes go: TRS = the MIDI jack, USB = USB, INT = into the Blackbox's own MIDI in, so its pads play what their MIDI settings say for that channel and note.

items.title: ENG
items.text: The detector's on/off switch. It starts off: turn it on to get notes.

items.title: Pads
items.text: Light up on a hit. Colour = velocity; they show the note and velocity.

items.title: Level meters
items.text: The live input level. The red line is the threshold.

items.title: SENS / THR
items.text: The sensitivity and threshold of the shown input.

items.title: History
items.text: The last four seconds of hits for each input. A bar's height is the velocity.

items.title: Knobs
items.text: While this sheet shows, the four knobs turn SENSITIVITY, THRESHOLD, RING GUARD and DEAD TIME, so you can set the threshold while watching the meter.

items.title: Sheets
items.text: HITS, DETECT and OUT.

items.title: Top bar
items.text: Hit counts and the last velocity of each input (L and R).

items.title: IN L / IN R
items.text: Chooses which input the page and its knobs show.

items.title: ON
items.text: Switches the shown input on or off.

items.title: TRS / USB / INT
items.text: Where the notes go: TRS = the MIDI jack, USB = USB, INT = into the Blackbox's own MIDI in, so its pads play what their MIDI settings say for that channel and note.

items.title: ENG
items.text: The detector's on/off switch. It starts off: turn it on to get notes.

items.title: SENSITIVITY
items.text: Input gain before detection. Raise for soft pads, lower for loud ones.

items.title: THRESHOLD
items.text: How loud a hit must be to count. Raise it to ignore bleed from other drums.

items.title: RING GUARD
items.text: After a hit, the level to beat fades slowly. Higher = ringing and echoes are ignored longer.

items.title: DEAD TIME
items.text: After a hit everything is ignored this long. Shorter = faster rolls, more double hits.

items.title: PEAK WINDOW
items.text: Time spent finding the hit's loudest point, which sets the velocity. 0 with fixed velocity.

items.title: SHARPNESS
items.text: How sharply the sound must jump above the background. Higher = only crisp hits count.

items.title: REACTION
items.text: How fast the detector reacts to an attack. Lower = quicker, more false hits.

items.title: TOUCH CURVE
items.text: Velocity feel. Below 1 soft hits come out louder; above 1 you have to hit harder.

items.title: BLEED GUARD
items.text: Rejects hits that ring on one pitch (bleed from other drums, resonance). OFF = never rejects.

items.title: GUARD REACH
items.text: How far above the threshold the bleed guard still checks a hit.

items.title: NOISE FLOOR
items.text: The quietest background a hit may start from. Lower lets tiny clicks in.

items.title: PRESETS
items.text: Starting points: DEFAULT, FAST, KICK, BLEED, ROLLS, SOFT. Tap one, then adjust.

items.title: Sheets
items.text: HITS, DETECT and OUT.

items.title: Top bar

items.title: ENG
items.text: The detector's on/off switch. It starts off: turn it on to get notes.

items.title: NOTE
items.text: The MIDI note sent for each hit. OFF = no note (hits still show on the page).

items.title: VELOCITY
items.text: DYN = follows how hard you hit. A number = every hit sends that velocity.

items.title: CC NUMBER
items.text: Also send this controller number with every hit. OFF = none.

items.title: CC VALUE
items.text: DYN = the value follows how hard you hit. A number = always that value.

items.title: NOTE LENGTH
items.text: DYN = the note ends when the hit has died away. A number = it ends after that many milliseconds.

items.title: CHANNEL
items.text: The MIDI channel of the notes and controllers.

items.title: Where it goes
items.text: TRS = MIDI jack, USB, INT = the Blackbox itself. The counter shows what was sent into the Blackbox.
